infobox.usage: Unlocks the room between 209 and 211 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm overseer key (Overseer) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "Overseer" on it. Appears to be extremely fragile, one-two uses and the key will break apart.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Against the Conscience - Part 1
- This is a required location for the quests Between Two Fires, Decisions, Decisions and Surprise Gift

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: In one of four locations at the smugglers' base. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the room between 209 and 211 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
